messages:
lina: heads-up: release candidate RC-2026-03-21 failed promotion. CI step 'upload-release-artifact' ended with file size 0 and registry 502. deploy-bot auto-paused the promote.
marc: any logs?
lina: snippet: `Step upload-release-artifact
-> POST /v2/releases/rc-2026-03-21/artifact.tar.gz
Response: 502 Bad Gateway
Wrote 0 bytes to /build/artifact.tar.gz`
deploy-bot: Promotion to stable blocked for RC-2026-03-21 due to artifact verification failure. Promotion status: PAUSED. Actions: rerun CI / replace artifact / manual-unblock.
marc: my guess is network egress glitch from ephemeral runners. do we have retries in the uploader?
build-bot: uploader retried 2x then failed; concurrency=8, chunk_size=8M.
ops-bot: Logging hold: RC-2026-03-21 paused at 2026-03-21T18:20:22Z. Change window: 2026-03-21 18:00-20:00 UTC. Owner: @tara.
tara: ok let's not rush. Plan: 1) pin current stable (2026-03-01) for the change window; 2) queue CI rerun with concurrency=2 + pre-clean /tmp; 3) if rerun fails, repackage and stream directly to registry to avoid disk.
lina: queued rerun with `CONCURRENCY=2` and `CLEAN_TMP=true` - job queued on runner-label=io-large, ETA ~10m.
marc: sounds good. also add checksum verification to the final step and fail-fast if size mismatch.
tara: agree. ops-bot please annotate release notes and hold spreadsheet: "Promotion paused - artifact upload 0 bytes; rerun in progress".
ops-bot: Updated release spreadsheet and release notes entry.
marc: if rerun succeeds, who will do manual-unblock?
tara: I'll verify checksums on the uploaded artifact and call `deploy-bot unblock --thread 6371112222 --by tara` after verification.
deploy-bot: manual-unblock requires: checksum match (sha256), artifact size > 1KB, and release-db pin cleared.
lina: rerun started @6371112290, will report outcome.
build-bot: rerun finished: uploader succeeded but checksum mismatch detected (expected sha256: abc123..., got def456...).
marc: hmm integrity mismatch — could be build nondeterminism. we should not promote. revert to pin and open a rebuild ticket.
tara: decision: DO NOT PROMOTE. Pin stable to 2026-03-01 for the window, open ticket BUILD-4389 to investigate nondeterministic artifact. I'll follow up with release notes and communicate to PMs.
ops-bot: Hold recorded: promotion blocked and pinned to previous stable. Ticket BUILD-4389 created and linked.
lina: thanks team — i'll close this thread after PM update.
